summary: Greedy on score_xp minus the shuffled-score greedy squad is +15.05 [+11.98, +17.92]. About +9.54 is the opening fifteen and +5.51 is a transfer-edge difference with no interval. Greedy on score_xp minus greedy on expected points is -1.67 [-4.44, +1.06] and covers zero. No winner and no threshold was applied. The one-week intercept is +1.16. The in-sample hurdle is +5.80. Leave-one-season-out hurdles are +5.00 to +7.23. Scraped xP Spearman with points is +0.59 against +0.23 for score_xp, which is the contamination reading. 2022-23 stays in the pool. Nothing is tuned.
